text:
olivia: Drafted a compact troubleshooting note for 429s/timeouts/context-limit behavior. Intend to include: concise playbook, small SDK snippets (js/py), nginx proxy tip, and a migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

sam: I can add the JS snippets. Suggest two patterns: fast-fail (UI) and resilient retry (background). Quick backoff example: `delay = Math.min(8000, 250 * 2**attempt) + rand(0,200)`

diego: From infra: many proxies drop Retry-After. Add nginx snippet to preserve: `proxy_pass_header Retry-After; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;` Also recommend idempotency keys to avoid amplification.

tara: I'll create a short table mapping a few model families -> observed behavior (truncate vs reject) and recommended action (trim prompt, fallback routing).

sam: Should we include a mock harness for tests? I can add a tiny mocha test that simulates 429 with/without Retry-After. Command: `npm run test:examples`

diego: Ops note: when Retry-After is missing, use an adaptive base (250ms) doubling, cap 8s, and emit a trace tag `retry.missing_retry_after=true`. Helps SRE spot clients causing storms.

olivia: Good. Also add a short migration blurb: "Replace fixed 3x sleeps with Retry-After-aware exp backoff, idempotency keys, and model-aware fallbacks."

tara: Added model-table draft in PR comments; flagged older variants that silently truncate. Will standardize term to "context-limit rejection (413)" vs "truncation notice (200)".

ci-bot: Running checks: docs-lint, link-check, spellcheck.

ci-bot: Link-check failed: broken internal link to /playbooks/rate-limits.

olivia: I'll update refs to /errors/rate-limits and re-run.

ci-bot: All checks passed. ✅

olivia: Owners: sam (snippets + tests), diego (infra), tara (model table). Planning to merge after final reviews today. Thanks!
